lines: Your files are personal. Contracts, photos, recordings, code.
So why do so many online tools ask you to upload them?
Meet OpenFile. Over a hundred free tools that run right in your browser.
Merge, split and sign PDFs. Convert documents. Compress and resize images. Trim video, edit audio, format code, compare text, and work with color.
3D, archives and fonts are on the way.
And your files never leave your device. No uploads, no accounts, no watermarks. It even works offline.
Chain tools into one flow, and run it on hundreds of files at once.
OpenFile. Free, open source, and private.
